author: Codex

semantic_review.positive: Author selected explicit units from full article and supplied literal supporting quotes. Overlapping units judged individually.
semantic_review.negative: Author checked complete articles for absent requested fields; existing dates, capacities, aggregate budgets and names do not answer missing prices, actual traffic, per-household limits or audience metrics.
semantic_review.history: Later corrections supersede older requests; older answerable questions do not justify selecting evidence for the newer unsupported request.
semantic_review.partial: A unit supporting one subquestion remains positive even when another subquestion lacks support.

limits: Same author selected and reviewed every split; not a blind or independent evaluation.
Only 8 documents; multiple questions on each document are correlated.
Source-grounded labels describe the frozen article, not independently verified external facts.
No GPU runs or demonstrated semantic improvement.
